artworks.title: Title Page for Leonard Lessius, De Ivstitia et Ivre
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an ornate title page bordered by figures and classical motifs. At the top, a female figure draped in flowing garments is seated amid clouds, holding scales symbolizing justice. A lion reclines beside her. Beneath her, the central portion of the illustration contains an oval frame with Latin text. On either side of the frame are classical female figures. Below the central frame, two muscular male figures recline in dynamic poses, their forms curling around the base of the title frame. The composition is detailed with floral and architectural embellishments typical of elaborate classical and Renaissance styles.

artworks.title: Title Page for Pedro de Ribadineira and Heribert Rosweyde, Generale Legende der Heylighen

artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page illustration featuring religious figures and ornate text. The image contains an assembly of figures clothed in classical robes surrounding a central figure seated on clouds, with a circular element behind their head. Celestial motifs such as stars are included, while various smaller figures populate the scene. At the bottom center, printed text is displayed on a billowing scroll. The composition is framed by a decorative margin.

artworks.title: Title Page for L. Annaei Senecae Philosophi Opera Qvae Exstant Omnia a Ivisto Lipsio
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a frontispiece of a book titled "L. Annaei Senecae Philosophi Opera quae extant omnia: a Justo Lipsio emendata et scholiis illustrata." The drawing displays an elaborate classical design with a highly detailed architectural frame. The top and bottom of the frame feature medallion portraits, and two figures stand on either side of the main title panel, each holding books or scrolls. Below the title, there are circular emblems with Latin inscriptions surrounded by bust portraits. The main text is in a serif font, reflecting the scholarly nature of the book. The composition is formal and symmetrical, typical of Renaissance-era book illustration.

artworks.title: Title Page for Franciscus van Haer, Annales Ducum seu Principum Brabantiae, III
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate title page. The drawing features a decorative architectural frame resembling a classical facade with two classical statues positioned on either side of a central inscription panel. The statues are dressed in flowing garments, each actively engaged in revealing the text. At the top of the page is a bust of a historical figure. Below the text panel, a collection of mythical creatures, serpentine in form, and various symbolic objects like armor and musical instruments are depicted, adding dramatic and symbolic elements to the composition.

artworks.title: Title Page for Franciscus Aguilonius, Historica Theologica et Moralis Terrae Sanctae Elvcidatio

artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed title page with classical and religious imagery. The illustration showcases various figures positioned around a central block of text. At the top, a central seated figure with a large tablet and staff is flanked by four other figures. The main text panel below this is framed by ornate classical architecture elements and contains Latin text. Additional figures are shown on either side, giving reverence to the text. The bottom panel depicts a reclining, partly-draped figure with smaller scenes on either side. The decorative framework and the style of illustration suggest influences from Renaissance or Baroque art movements.

artworks.title: Title Page for Balthasar Cordier, Iob Elvcidatvs

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical illustration within a book page. The central figure is gesturing upwards, surrounded by others in varying postures. The central figure is seated on a rock and is partially clothed. Two other figures are standing to the left, while another figure sits to the right. The scene features dark clouds, light shining from above, and architectural structures in the background. Cherubic figures are depicted below, holding symbols and scrollwork around a text panel.

The background features dramatic clouds, light beams, and castle-like structures. In the lower portion, two cherubs hold shields, flanking an archway with a blank area.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with God the Father, Two Saints, and a Serpent
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative border surrounding a blank rectangular space. The drawing features an ornate frame design with mythical and celestial figures on each side of the rectangle. At the top of the composition, there is a figure emerging from clouds with outstretched arms, positioned centrally. Flanking the rectangle are two figures; one is on the left standing on a crescent moon, accompanied by floral elements, and the other on the right appears to be standing atop clouds, surrounded by a radiant aura. At the bottom of the design, the initials "MRA" are featured prominently, with swirling serpentine shapes and more floral elements. Overall, this drawing has a classical and baroque style, rich with allegorical symbols.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Saints and Scenes from the Life of Christ
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural frame. The artwork includes an ornate vertical rectangular frame centered within a blank page, with detailed illustrations adorning its borders. The upper portion features figures draped in classical robes, while the lower section includes cherubs holding a garland and a small inset scene depicting individuals in discussion. The left and right borders include architectural elements and figures, with one side showing a building structure and the other a person engaged in labor under an archway. The frame's aesthetic is influenced by classical and baroque elements, emphasizing symmetry and detail.

artworks.title: Border Illustration for the Missale Romanum: The Tree of Jesse

Each side of the frame consists of figures in flowing garments, some holding musical instruments or engaging in conversation. The composition creates a sense of movement and storytelling around the central blank space. The detailed shading and line work suggest a high level of craftsmanship, emphasizing the depth and texture of the figures and leaves.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Putti Harvesting Offerings to God
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of an ornate frame with detailed illustrations. The frame is decorated with various symbolic elements, including cherubs, agricultural motifs, and religious symbols. 

The top portion features two cherubs facing a central chalice with a radiant symbol above it, flanked by items that resemble bread and wine. The sides of the frame include designs of sheaves of wheat tied together and what appear to be grapevines. At the bottom, there are cherubs engaged in agricultural activities, such as one holding a sickle and others tending to sheaves of wheat or attending a basin. The overall composition suggests a celebration of agriculture and spirituality through its rich iconography.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Two Putti "Scientia, Fortitvdo, Pietas, Timor-DNI, Sapientia, Intellectvs, Consilivm"
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame with empty space in the center. The illustration depicts an intricately designed border surrounding an empty central area. The border includes decorative elements such as two small cherub-like figures at the bottom, one holding a cross and the other a shepherd's crook. Above them is a Latin inscription "TIMOR DNI," which translates to "Fear of the Lord." The top portion of the border features an eagle with outspread wings amidst architectural elements reminiscent of columns and pediments. Surrounding the frame are additional Latin words: "SCIENTIA," "FORTITUDO," "PIETAS," "SAPIENTIA," "INTELLECTUS," and "CONSILIUM," which translate to "Knowledge," "Fortitude," "Piety," "Wisdom," "Understanding," and "Counsel" respectively. The style of the drawing suggests influences of classical and baroque art periods, emphasized by the grandeur and detail in the architectural motifs and the allegorical figures.

The color palette is grayscale, with varying shades of black and white. Positioned at each corner are cherubs, two on each side of the rectangular space in the center, with symmetrical elements at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Title Page for Cornelii Iansenii ... Avgvstinvs
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features three religious figures, depicted waist up in a triangular composition. The central figure is a bearded man with long hair, wearing a mitre and holding a heart with a flame in his left hand, while pointing upwards with his right. Flanking him are two other bearded men wearing mitres and holding staffs. Both hold texts, with the left figure wearing robes adorned with a cross. The scene includes engravings of flourishes and symbols, with the Latin inscription "CHARITAS DEI" above them in the clouds, illuminated with rays. The engraving is framed by an ornate border and a title plaque at the base contains detailed Latin text about Cornelius Jansen, with elaborate scrollwork and decorative motifs. The background is filled with stylized clouds and radiant light, set on a plain background, suggesting it is part of a book or manuscript.

artworks.title: Title Page for Liutprand, Opera
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle II after Erasmus Quellinus II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring classical figures and ornate heraldic elements surrounding a central column containing text. The image showcases a detailed composition where a seated female figure is placed atop a grand pedestal with flowing garments, holding a torch and an orb. She is accompanied by various mythological and symbolical figures, such as a muscular man with a cross and a male figure in a robe gesturing upwards. Shields, flowing banners, and floral decorations enrich the scene, while a rectangular base with engravings adds another layer of intricate detail. The setting evokes themes of knowledge, enlightenment, and possibly honor or memory, indicated by the textual inscriptions and decorative motifs representative of classical art styles and scholarly publications.
